rounds.text: Ravelcare Ltd presents a compelling case for undervaluation, trading at a P/E of 10.7x [E1] against a sector benchmark of 17.14x [E6], while maintaining a robust 30.5% ROCE [E12] that significantly outperforms the sector benchmark of 10.4% [E10]. The company’s historical performance is marked by exceptional growth, with a 5-year compounded profit growth of 119% [E16] and a 3-year compounded sales growth of 98% [E14]. Furthermore, the firm is conservatively financed with 0.00x debt-to-equity [E27], providing a stable foundation for its operations. A discounted cash flow analysis suggests an intrinsic value of Rs 344 per share, implying a substantial margin of safety of 73.9% at the current market price [E34, E35]. Conceded: the company faces challenges with negative operating cash flow of Rs -17.47 Cr [E25], a lack of dividend payouts [E4, E42], and institutional outflows [E33, E50]. Despite these headwinds, the market price currently implies a -0.6% earnings growth, which stands in stark contrast to the company's proven ability to deliver 23% profit growth in the trailing twelve months [E18, E36].
